problem_title: Get lists of dependent picklist options in Apex
problem: I have a pair of dependent picklists. In Apex code, how can I determine what options are valid in the dependent field for each option in the controlling field? I've tried using getPicklistValues() , but there doesn't seem to be any way of getting dependency information. Example Controlling_Field__c Fruit, Vegetable, Dairy Dependent_Field__c (Fruit): Apple, Banana, Pear (Vegetable): Tomato, Egglant, Lettuce (Dairy):...
fixed_code:
example pke.validFor: g      A      A      A
displayed as bits:    100000 000000 000000 000000
rearranged as bytes:  10000000 00000000 00000000
